title: Laptop battery swollen? Stop using it today
summary: A swollen battery can damage your laptop and is a fire risk. Here's what to do.
answer: If your laptop battery is swollen, stop using and charging the laptop, shut it down, and get the battery replaced. A swollen lithium battery can crack the case and can catch fire.
points: Signs: the touchpad or keyboard lifts up, the bottom bulges, or the laptop rocks on a flat table.
Unplug the charger and shut the laptop down.
Don't press on the bulge, and don't try to open or pierce the battery.
Keep it away from heat, beds and anything that can burn.
Get the battery replaced. Don't keep using the laptop "until it stops working."
ask: Hi, mero laptop ko battery phuleko jasto chha.
